text:
alex: quick heads-up — noticed an issue with gateway rewrite rule for legacy-host profiles. presigned S3 PUTs fail when client sends duplicate `?x=1&x=2` params; our query-dedupe step collapses them into a single `x=2` and signature mismatch. hit this while migrating partner uploads.

marta: ouch. which route? any repro?

alex: /internal/uploads/s3-proxy — repro curl:
```
curl -v "https://api.redwood.example/internal/uploads/s3-proxy?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Credential=...&x=1&x=2" -H "Host: storage.partner.com"
```
gateway log shows rewrite: `normalized_query: x=2&X-Amz-...` — we reorder + dedupe.

sam: we added dedupe in 2024-11 to normalize caching. it helped cache hit rate but never thought about presigned signatures. :grimacing: 

jordan: telemetry check — spike in 403s on s3-proxy routes since deploy 2024-11-02. correlated with rewrite PR #5027

marta: options:
- special-case s3-presigned routes by detecting `X-Amz-Signature|X-Amz-Algorithm` and bypass dedupe
- add per-route flag `preserve_query_order` default false
- change cache key to include canonicalized vs raw query and make dedupe opt-in

sam: prefer per-route flag so customers opt-in. but console UX needs to make it obvious (dangerous to flip). Also need metrics to detect regressions.

alex: another wrinkle — host header injection runs after query normalization, so if we switch off dedupe for presigned we still might reorder host vs query in logs. maybe run host-preserve earlier.

jordan: I can make a small PR: detect presigned pattern and set route.metadata.preserve_query=true during onboarding migration for partner routes. but need product sign-off.

marta: product OK with opt-in for partner migration. UX: console will show "Legacy request preservation (may affect cache)". Also add telemetry event `route.preserve_query.enabled` and a regression alert when 5xx/403 rates change by >20%.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary: rewrite-fix-preserve-query -> deploy/2060

alex: ok I'll write the test matrix (curl cases with duplicate keys, different ordering, and signed urls). Jordan can own PR.

sam: @jordan assign to me for code review. I'll add a flag in routing policy parser: `preserve_raw_query=true`.

jordan: assigning. thanks. :thumbsup: 

marta: can we also add a lint in route validator to prevent accidental enablement on public-facing cacheable routes? add to checklist.

alex: agreed. file a follow-up issue for docs + migration steps.
